    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "10 Gemini prompts to help you keep your New Year\u0027s resolutions"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><p data-block-key="lq8w4">When New Year's resolutions don’t work out, a lack of planning is often to blame. This year, Gemini can help you fix that. Using <a href="https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/14200040?hl=en">the right prompts</a>,<a href="https://blog.google/products/gemini/scheduled-actions-gemini-app/"> scheduled actions</a> and <a href="https://blog.google/products/workspace/workspace-june-drop-gemini-workspace-apps/">connected apps</a>, you can instantly create detailed guides and structured learning paths that fit your life. Here are 10 prompts you can adapt to help you stick to your resolutions.</p><p data-block-key="7h0po">As you build momentum, you can adjust them, ask Gemini to add tasks to your calendar to stay organized and even <a href="https://blog.google/products/gemini/google-gems-tips/">create your own Gems</a>, custom versions of Gemini that remember your goals and act as dedicated experts. That way, you’ll never need to start from scratch.</p><ol><li data-block-key="3vpge"><b>Create a custom workout plan.</b> Give Gemini your starting point and your goal to get a step-by-step schedule that builds over time. Use <a href="https://blog.google/products/gemini/temporary-chats-privacy-controls/">personalization features</a> to reference past chats for an even more tailored plan. You can even ask it to save specific instructions — i.e: <i>Remember I live in NYC and only have access to a treadmill.<br/><br/></i><b>Prompt:</b> <i>I want to run the New York City marathon in 6 months. I recently finished a half marathon in 2 hours, and I can train 5 days a week. Create a monthly training plan that will help me continue to build my endurance.<br/></i></li><li data-block-key="6es29"><b>Declutter your home.</b> Use Gemini to create a structured, daily plan that makes organizational projects feel less overwhelming. Supplement your project using <a href="https://blog.google/products/gemini/gemini-live-android-tips/">Gemini Live with camera sharing</a> to get real-time feedback.<br/><br/><b>Prompt:</b> <i>I want to organize and declutter my apartment this month. Create a 30-day plan that breaks the process into simple, daily tasks that take no more than 20 minutes each and won’t require me to purchase any new items.<br/></i></li><li data-block-key="fdbdt"><b>Learn a new language.</b> Tell Gemini your goal and available time, and it will structure a curriculum and <a href="https://blog.google/products/gemini/new-gemini-tools-students-august-2025/">generate interactive study tools</a> to keep you motivated and test your progress.<br/><br/><b>Prompt:</b> <i>I’d like to learn basic French. Generate a 30-day guided learning plan for these topics and create an interactive multiple-choice quiz on the verb conjugations. Please also generate a set of flashcards for the 50 phrases.<br/></i></li><li data-block-key="gnrm"><b>Advance your career.</b> Use Gemini to <a href="https://blog.google/products/gemini/gemini-3-examples-demos/">refine your interview skills</a>, analyze a presentation video and generate a professional headshot. Bonus step: Upload a headshot to Gemini and use Nano Banana to add some professional polish for platforms like LinkedIn.<br/><br/><b>Prompt:</b> <i>I have a job interview next week for [role]. Simulate a live, conversational interview with me, focusing on behavioral questions. Second, create a detailed feedback report after I upload my video rehearsal, analyzing my speaking pace, body language and use of filler words.<br/></i></li><li data-block-key="986ik"><b>Eat healthier.</b> Ask Gemini to <a href="https://blog.google/products/gemini/scheduled-actions-gemini-app/">schedule a weekly</a> meal plan tailored to your specific dietary needs and preferences, eliminating the stress of deciding what to cook.<br/><br/><b>Prompt:</b> <i>I want to eat healthier. Every Sunday at 9 a.m., please create a 7-day, high-protein and vegetarian-friendly dinner plan. I have about 45 minutes to cook each night. Include a grocery list for the week.</i><br/></li><li data-block-key="bskt7"><b>Create a better budget.</b> By asking Gemini to analyze spending data <a href="https://blog.google/products/workspace/workspace-june-drop-gemini-workspace-apps/">from connected apps</a>, you can get specific, actionable and personalized budgeting rules to implement weekly.<br/><br/><b>Prompt:</b> <i>Analyze the uploaded Google Sheet containing my monthly spending for the last quarter and identify 3 areas of non-essential spending. Suggest practical weekly budgeting rules I can immediately implement to save 15%.<br/></i></li><li data-block-key="63kr1"><b>Create a custom reading list.</b> Combine expert recs with a manageable pace, keeping you from getting overwhelmed by a backlog of books. Use <a href="https://blog.google/products/gemini/scheduled-actions-gemini-app/">recurring actions</a> to get a fresh set of recommendations every month.<br/><br/><b>Prompt:</b> <i>I want to read 12 business books in 2026. Schedule a recurring action for the first of every month: Suggest a list of 5 non-fiction titles related to advertising and create a sample monthly reading and review schedule.<br/></i></li><li data-block-key="4u2cn"><b>Replace a bad habit with a good one.</b> ID the triggers for your bad habits and find concrete replacements.<br/><br/><b>Prompt:</b> <i>I want to reduce my phone screen time by 2 hours a week. Outline a 'Habit Replacement Plan' that identifies my typical trigger times and suggests a positive alternative activity for each.<br/></i></li><li data-block-key="6fnk3"><b>Overcome the blank page.</b> Use this prompt to get low-friction creative ideas that help you defeat "blank page" syndrome and keep your new creative habit going.<br/><br/><b>Prompt:</b> <i>Give me 7 unique, one-sentence journaling prompts for the week that encourage reflection on my goals and progress.<br/></i></li><li data-block-key="ffuc0"><b>Plan for long-term success.</b> This future-facing prompt encourages you to think long-term, helping you scale up successful habits and make your resolution a permanent lifestyle change.<br/><br/><b>Prompt:</b> <i>It's July 1st. I've successfully maintained my resolution to [resolution name] for 6 months. Create a 3-part maintenance plan to help me make this a permanent habit and set a bigger goal for the rest of 2026.</i></li></ol><p data-block-key="ch20d">A good plan can be the difference between a goal and a long-term habit. This year, instead of starting with a vague idea, give Gemini the details to build a roadmap you can actually follow.</p></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>
